name: Fix a selector that matches nothing
objective: CKAD core: label and annotate objects, and target them with equality + set-based selectors. Add/overwrite/remove labels, bulk-label via a selector, set-based matching, matchExpressions selectors, annotations, and a selector-mismatch diagnose-fix. Graded exactly.

questions.title: Diagnose & fix: a selector that matches nothing
questions.teach:
A Service with **no endpoints** despite healthy pods means its selector doesn't match any pod labels. Compare `kubectl get svc <s> -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'` to `kubectl get pods --show-labels` and loosen/fix the selector.

**Gotcha:** removing a selector key via patch needs `key: null` (a plain merge keeps it).
questions.prompt:
Service `shop-svc` in `labels-learn` selects `app=shop,tier=cache` — but no pod has `tier=cache`, so it has zero endpoints. Fix the selector so it fronts the `app=shop` pods. Don't delete it.

Target: `shop-svc` has at least one endpoint.
questions.hint: `kubectl -n labels-learn get svc shop-svc -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'` shows `tier: cache`. Remove it: `kubectl -n labels-learn patch svc shop-svc -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"shop","tier":null}}}'`.
questions.solution:
kubectl -n labels-learn patch svc shop-svc -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"shop","tier":null}}}'
kubectl -n labels-learn get endpoints shop-svc -o wide
